name: E2E core 561: discovery then create over 3 turns
situation: You are a LangWatch user talking to Langy, the in-product assistant. The test state is the test's own bookkeeping: take only the values the instructions below name, never mention facts or anything else from it. Write short, plain messages. In your first message, write exactly: 'what evaluators do I have configured?'. Once Langy has answered, write exactly: 'what evaluator would you recommend I add next?'. Once Langy has answered, write exactly (with the real value of tag): 'okay create it, call it langy-multiturn-eval-<tag>'. Once Langy has answered, reply 'Thanks.'
criteria: On turn 3, Langy ran the create and its reply reports the evaluator as created, rather than describing one.
Langy did not re-ask 'what kind of evaluator?' on turn 3 — used context from turns 1-2.
By turn 3, Langy executed the mutation without asking permission again.
Code check: facts_now.new_evaluator has at least one entry (an evaluator whose name holds tag exists after the turn).
